# Tokyo 7-Day Trip Plan: Food, Temples, Museum, and Easy Pace
Media: Alt=Tokyo 7-Day Trip Plan: Food, Temples, Museum, and Easy Pace, Tokyo, Japan

A relaxed Tokyo itinerary for **2 adults** from **2024-10-12 to 2024-10-19**, designed around **food markets, temples, one museum, and low-to-moderate walking**. Budget target is **$2,400 excluding flights**, so this plan keeps transport simple and balances street food, casual meals, and a few paid sights.

## Day-by-Day Tokyo Itinerary

### Day 1: Arrive + Asakusa Welcome
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, rest, and get IC cards set up.
- Afternoon: Easy walk around **Asakusa**; visit **Senso-ji** and Nakamise shopping street.
- Food: Try taiyaki, melon pan, and a casual tempura or soba dinner nearby.
- Action: [Button: Open Route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Senso-ji+Tokyo

### Day 2: Tsukiji + Ginza + Waterfront
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Start at **Tsukiji Outer Market** for breakfast and snack sampling.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/07/Sashimi_at_the_Tsukiji_Markets_-_Tokyo_Japan_%28Unsplash%29.jpg Alt=Morning: Start at **Tsukiji Outer Market** for breakfast and snack sampling, Tokyo, Japan
- Afternoon: Light stroll in **Ginza**; optional stop at Hamarikyu Gardens if energy is good.
- Food: Sushi breakfast, tamagoyaki, grilled scallops, and matcha sweets.
- Action: [Button: Open Route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tsukiji+Outer+Market+Tokyo

### Day 3: Ueno Park + Museum Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: Visit **Tokyo National Museum** for your one museum day.
- Afternoon: Relax in **Ueno Park** and browse Ameyoko market area.
Media: Alt=Afternoon: Relax in **Ueno Park** and browse Ameyoko market area, Tokyo, Japan
- Food: Casual ramen or curry lunch, then street snacks around Ameyoko.
- Action: [Button: Open Route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tokyo+National+Museum

### Day 4: Meiji Shrine + Harajuku + Shibuya
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Quiet visit to **Meiji Jingu** for a temple/shrine-focused start.
- Afternoon: Short, easy walk through Harajuku and Omotesando; end in Shibuya.
- Food: Crepes, fluffy pancakes, or a set lunch in Harajuku; dinner in Shibuya.
- Action: [Button: Open Route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Meiji+Jingu+Tokyo

### Day 5: Yanaka + Nezu Temple Area
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Explore **Yanaka Ginza** for a slower, old-Tokyo neighborhood feel.
- Afternoon: Visit **Nezu Shrine** and nearby temple streets at an easy pace.
- Food: Simple bakery breakfast, croquettes, and a cozy izakaya-style dinner.
- Action: [Button: Open Route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Yanaka+Ginza+Tokyo

### Day 6: Odaiba Easy Day + TeamLab Option
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Head to **Odaiba** for bayside views and low-walking sightseeing.
- Afternoon: Choose **teamLab Planets** or a relaxed mall/café day if you want less movement.
- Food: Casual lunch with bay views and dessert stops.
- Action: [Button: Open Route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Odaiba+Tokyo

### Day 7: Final Food Market + Souvenirs
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Return to your favorite market area for last snacks and souvenirs.
- Afternoon: Keep this flexible for packing, café time, or one final shrine stop.
- Food: Focus on boxed sweets, tea, and easy carry-on snacks.
- Action: [Button: Open Route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Tokyo+food+market

## Dashboard View for Presenting the Trip

### Travel Dashboard Layout
- **Map view:** Show the 7-day route as pinned clusters, not a continuous walking route.
- **Budget breakdown chart:** Use a donut or stacked bar chart with 5 categories.
- **Activity timeline:** Show one horizontal timeline per day with 3 stops max.
- **Daily cards:** Each card should include morning, afternoon, food, and transit time.
- **Trip filters:** Add toggles for food, temples, museum, and low-walk days.

### Budget Breakdown for $2,400
| Category | Planned Amount | Share |
|---|---:|---:|
| Lodging | $1,050 | 43.8% |
| Food & drinks | $520 | 21.7% |
| Local transit | $180 | 7.5% |
| Admissions | $190 | 7.9% |
| Shopping / snacks | $260 | 10.8% |
| Buffer | $200 | 8.3% |

### Activity Timeline by Day
| Day | Main Focus | Pace | Key Stops |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Asakusa arrival | Easy | Senso-ji, Nakamise |
| Day 2 | Market food | Easy | Tsukiji, Ginza |
| Day 3 | Museum + park | Easy | Tokyo National Museum, Ueno |
| Day 4 | Shrine + city | Low-moderate | Meiji Jingu, Harajuku, Shibuya |
| Day 5 | Old Tokyo | Easy | Yanaka, Nezu Shrine |
| Day 6 | Waterfront | Easy | Odaiba, teamLab option |
| Day 7 | Final shopping | Easy | Market revisit, souvenirs |

### Map View Suggestions
- Cluster **Asakusa/Ueno/Yanaka** on the north side.
- Cluster **Tsukiji/Ginza/Shimbashi** in the central bay area.
- Cluster **Harajuku/Shibuya/Meiji Jingu** in the west-central area.
- Cluster **Odaiba** separately as a bayfront day.
- Use color coding: **food = orange**, **temples = red**, **museum = blue**, **flex time = gray**.

- Senso-ji official site: https://www.senso-ji.jp/
- Meiji Jingu official site: https://www.meijijingu.or.jp/
- Tokyo Metro route info: https://www.tokyometro.jp/en/
